key: BOREALIS: Enough.
en: BOREALIS: Enough.
ja: ボレアリス: もう　じゅうぶんだ

key: There's no point in running further.
en: There's no point in running further.
ja: これ以上　逃げても　意味は　ない

key: Not for me at least.
en: Not for me at least.
ja: 少なくとも　わたしには　な

key: Not weeks ago that woman was just a lowly recruit.
en: Not weeks ago that woman was just a lowly recruit.
ja: ほんの数週間前まで　あの女は　下っぱの新入りだった

key: One promotion later and now she thinks she can do whatever she wants--
en: One promotion later and now she thinks she can do whatever she wants--
ja: 一度の昇進で　今や　何でも　思いどおりに　できると　思っている——

key: And worse, because of that idiot girl, she will be proven right.
en: And worse, because of that idiot girl, she will be proven right.
ja: さらに悪いことに　あのおろかな娘の　せいで　それが　正しかったと　証明される

key: A thousand cautions were clearly not enough, and what is it all for now?!
en: A thousand cautions were clearly not enough, and what is it all for now?!
ja: 千の忠告でも　足りなかった。それが　今や　何のためだったと　いうのだ!?

key: BOREALIS: ...There is no point in hiding it now.
en: BOREALIS: ...There is no point in hiding it now.
ja: ボレアリス: ……もう　かくす意味も　ない

key: COREY: So much for you leaving us well enough alone earlier.
en: COREY: So much for you leaving us well enough alone earlier.
ja: コーリー: さっき　わたしたちを　そっとしておくという話は　どうなったのかな

key: Because I moved to spare my imbecile of a daughter, I will be branded a traitor, cut off, and disposed of.
en: Because I moved to spare my imbecile of a daughter, I will be branded a traitor, cut off, and disposed of.
ja: おろかな娘を　かばって動いたせいで　わたしは　裏切り者の　らく印を　押され　切り捨てられ　始末される

key: COREY: Because I moved to spare my imbecile of a daughter, I will be branded a traitor, cut off, and disposed of.
en: COREY: Because I moved to spare my imbecile of a daughter, I will be branded a traitor, cut off, and disposed of.
ja: コーリー: おろかな娘を　かばって動いたせいで　わたしは　裏切り者の　らく印を　押され　切り捨てられ　始末される

key: I have treaded a razor's edge for years to keep her safe-- only for her to ruin it of her own accord.
en: I have treaded a razor's edge for years to keep her safe-- only for her to ruin it of her own accord.
ja: あの子を　守るために　何年も　かみそりの刃の上を　歩いてきた——それを　あの子自身が　台なしにした

key: Blast!
en: Blast!
ja: くっ!

key: But of you--
en: But of you--
ja: だが お前には——

key: You, who has been witness to my virtues besides my sins,
en: You, who has been witness to my virtues besides my sins,
ja: わが罪だけでなく わが徳をも見てきた者よ

key: You, who has been witness to my undoing,
en: You, who has been witness to my undoing,
ja: わが破滅を見届けた者よ

key: You, who has been conscripted to hunt me down regardless,
en: You, who has been conscripted to hunt me down regardless,
ja: それでもなお 私を追う役目を負わされた者よ

key: I would ask of you a favor.
en: I would ask of you a favor.
ja: 一つ 頼みがある

key: Meet me at my home.
en: Meet me at my home.
ja: 私の家に来い

key: It is not far from here.
en: It is not far from here.
ja: ここから そう遠くはない

key: Face me as your merry band of vigilante fools would have bade you do so.
en: Face me as your merry band of vigilante fools would have bade you do so.
ja: あの正義ごっこの仲間たちが 望んだとおりに 私と向き合え

key: It is better to be undone at the hand of an enemy than one who purported to be a colleague.
en: It is better to be undone at the hand of an enemy than one who purported to be a colleague.
ja: 仲間を装った者よりも 敵の手で滅ぼされるほうが まだましだ

key: I'll be waiting.
en: I'll be waiting.
ja: 待っている

key: STREET RAT: Excuse me, sir...
en: STREET RAT: Excuse me, sir...
ja: ごろつき: すみません 旦那……

key: Could I trouble you for just a moment?
en: Could I trouble you for just a moment?
ja: ちょっと お時間 よろしいですか?

key: BOREALIS: Step aside; I don't have time for charity right now.
en: BOREALIS: Step aside; I don't have time for charity right now.
ja: ボレアリス: どけ。施しをしている暇はない

key: STREET RAT: Sorry about it, sir...
en: STREET RAT: Sorry about it, sir...
ja: ごろつき: 申し訳ないんですが 旦那……

key: ...But I really can't do that...
en: ...But I really can't do that...
ja: ……それは できないんですよ……

key: OFFICER: ...Because, sir, you're under arrest.
en: OFFICER: ...Because, sir, you're under arrest.
ja: けいかん: ……なぜなら あなたは 逮捕されるからだ

key: BOREALIS: ...I had heard under good authority that Reborn City's police department was indisposed.
en: BOREALIS: ...I had heard under good authority that Reborn City's police department was indisposed.
ja: ボレアリス: ……リボーンシティの警察は 機能していないと 確かな筋から聞いていたが

key: CHIEF: That might've been true-- until recently!
en: CHIEF: That might've been true-- until recently!
ja: しょちょう: そうだったかもな——つい最近までは!

key: But thanks to \PN here, we were able to round up enough men to pull one quick sting operation at the request of a certain Gym Leader.
en: But thanks to \PN here, we were able to round up enough men to pull one quick sting operation at the request of a certain Gym Leader.
ja: だが \PNのおかげで 人員をそろえ あるジムリーダーの依頼で おとり捜査を仕掛けられた

key: BOREALIS: ...You.
en: BOREALIS: ...You.
ja: ボレアリス: ……お前か

key: ...And that Leader.
en: ...And that Leader.
ja: ……そして あのリーダーか

key: She sent us this way knowing I'd walk face-first into an ambush.
en: She sent us this way knowing I'd walk face-first into an ambush.
ja: 私が待ち伏せに飛び込むと知って ここへ差し向けたのだな

key: So much for her supposed "compassion".
en: So much for her supposed "compassion".
ja: 彼女の言う「思いやり」も 大したものだ

key: CHIEF: Now let's see who you really are!
en: CHIEF: Now let's see who you really are!
ja: しょちょう: さあ 正体を見せてもらおうか!

key: CHIEF: Corey Molinar...?
en: CHIEF: Corey Molinar...?
ja: しょちょう: コーリー・モリナー……?

key: ...I don't understand--
en: ...I don't understand--
ja: ……わけが わからん——

key: You were working with us to control damages from and pinpoint Team Meteor's operations!
en: You were working with us to control damages from and pinpoint Team Meteor's operations!
ja: あんたは メテオだんの動きを突き止め 被害を抑えるために 協力していたはずだ!

key: You were a former Leader yourself!
en: You were a former Leader yourself!
ja: あんた自身 元ジムリーダーだったんだぞ!

key: For how long have you been a double agent?!
en: For how long have you been a double agent?!
ja: いつから 二重スパイをやっていた?!

key: COREY: I've been cleaning your information since I was given access to it.
en: COREY: I've been cleaning your information since I was given access to it.
ja: コーリー: 情報に触れられるようになった時から ずっと消してきた

key: How callow of you to trust me simply because I was once part of the league.
en: How callow of you to trust me simply because I was once part of the league.
ja: かつてリーグの一員だったというだけで信じるとは 浅はかだな

key: Even more to believe that I'm alone either.
en: Even more to believe that I'm alone either.
ja: 私が一人だと思い込むのは なおさらだ

key: Trust on the basis of authority is inherently fallacious.
en: Trust on the basis of authority is inherently fallacious.
ja: 権威にもとづく信頼など 本質的に誤りだ

key: It exists on the notion of believing in a promise that no one made.
en: It exists on the notion of believing in a promise that no one made.
ja: 誰も交わしていない約束を 信じるようなものだ

key: CHIEF: Those are big words for someone who's going to be facing the judge soon.
en: CHIEF: Those are big words for someone who's going to be facing the judge soon.
ja: しょちょう: じきに裁きを受ける男にしては 大した口をきくな

key: COREY: You'd be a fool to count on that either.
en: COREY: You'd be a fool to count on that either.
ja: コーリー: それを当てにするのも 愚かなことだ

key: Never underestimate the strength of someone who has nothing left to lose.
en: Never underestimate the strength of someone who has nothing left to lose.
ja: 失うものが何もない者の強さを 甘く見るな

key: CHIEF: Gone just like that, hm?
en: CHIEF: Gone just like that, hm?
ja: しょちょう: 一瞬で消えた……か

key: Check his house first-- just north of here!
en: Check his house first-- just north of here!
ja: まず あいつの家だ——ここから北にある!

key: We can clinch this yet!
en: We can clinch this yet!
ja: まだ 決着はつけられる!

key: Move quickly!
en: Move quickly!
ja: 急げ!
